title: Nails and staples.
officialText:
Nails and staples shall conform to requirements of ASTM F 1667. Nails used for framing and
sheathing connections shall have minimum average bending yield strengths as follows: 80 kips per square inch (ksi)
(551 MPa) for shank diameters larger than 0.177 inch (4.50 mm) but not larger than 0.254 inch (6.45 mm), 90 ksi (620
MPa) for shank diameters larger than 0.142 inch (3.61 mm) but not larger than 0.177 inch (4.50 mm) and 100 ksi
(689 MPa) for shank diameters of at least 0.099 inch (2.51 mm) but not larger than 0.142 inch (3.61 mm).
